Fifth, consider tax — ISA returns are tax-free, but mortgage overpayments are not tax-deductible. Sixth, consider your pension — if your employer matches contributions, that's a 100% return before you even invest. Seventh, inflation erodes the real value of both your mortgage debt and your savings over time. Eighth, compound interest means early investments grow more. Ninth, you might want to split — some toward the mortgage, some toward investing. Tenth, consider speaking to a financial adviser for a personal recommendation.
